polaris: LP29-C2T-S2 / context baseline vs reproduced Srivastava exact O_s baseline
framework: Literature-first reproducibility audit: distinguish reported orbital-overlap context from a machine-reviewable exact O_s reproduction baseline requiring formula/code, raw overlap sum, normalization rule, pair cutoff, same-structure mapping, and witness payload.

findings.summary: Srivastava 2019 (DOI 10.1063/1.5096042) is a valid literature context source for reported orbital-overlap values and effective-mass correlation, but the A-side evidence available in this round does not support labeling those values as reproduced exact O_s. Crossref confirms the paper metadata, DOI, abstract, AIP URL, official PDF URL, and the claim that an orbital overlap integral can be calculated from structural information and correlates with effective mass. However, paper-search-mcp arXiv search returned no arXiv record; Unpaywall returned no open OA record; AIP PDF direct access was blocked by a JavaScript/cookie challenge; and the successful fallback download was identified as a different 2015 Scientific Reports article, so it was excluded as Srivastava evidence. The local C2 Srivastava rows contain reported OI_norm values and method labels, but not OI_raw_sum, structure_id, atom count, executable normalization witness, or same-structure mapping. Therefore reported OI_norm remains context-only and must not be written as reproduced O_s.
positive_support_for_context_baseline: Crossref DOI lookup for 10.1063/1.5096042 identifies Srivastava, Nahas, Bhowmick, and Gaur, Journal of Applied Physics 126, article 125702, published 2019-09-23.

Crossref abstract states the work compares a-IGZO and a-ZnON, discusses transport paths through outer s-orbital overlap, and reports direct correlation between orbital overlap integral and carrier effective mass.
Local C2_Srivastava_baseline_rows.csv records four reported_table_and_text rows with OI_norm and m_eff_over_m0 values for a-IGZO and a-ZnON.
negative_support_against_reproduced_base: No arXiv record was found for the DOI/title/query set.
No Unpaywall open-access metadata was returned for DOI 10.1063/1.5096042.
AIP official PDF URL from Crossref could not be retrieved automatically because pubs.aip.org returned a JavaScript/cookie challenge.

paper-search-mcp fallback downloaded core_38590358.pdf, but text extraction showed it is Lee et al., Scientific Reports 5:13467 (2015), DOI 10.1038/srep13467, not Srivastava 2019; it was rejected as evidence.
Local Srivastava baseline rows leave structure_id, num_atoms, OI_raw_sum, and residual fields blank and mark decisive_claim_allowed=false.

C2T witness requirements explicitly require OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A or exact pair rule, structure_id, source_row_id, and mode declaration before Srivastava reproduction can pass.
findings.decision_rule: Use Srivastava 2019 only as reported_context_only unless a source-row-specific witness payload supplies exact formula/procedure, raw overlap sum, normalization, pair selection, and structure mapping.

weakest_link: The weakest link is not the existence of Srivastava 2019 or its reported OI/effective-mass correlation; it is the missing row-level executable witness tying reported OI_norm to OI_raw_sum, normalization, pair selection, and the exact atomistic structure used for the same sample.

next_plan.round2_focus: Try to obtain the official AIP PDF/SI through library/manual access or author repository, then extract Table II, Fig. 4 context, SI section on STO/Mulliken orbital weights, and any downloadable structure files. If no such payload exists, produce S2_Srivastava_reproduction_blocker_table.
next_plan.minimum_success_condition: At least one Srivastava row has source_row_id, structure_id, OI_comparison_mode=srivastava_reproduction, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A or exact pair-selection rule, and provenance linking all fields to the same structure.
next_plan.fallback_if_blocked: Keep reported OI_norm as context-only and route LP29-C2T validation through a newly declared fixed_density or fixed_pair baseline rather than Srivastava reproduction.
